sources.title: Agentico - GitHub
sources.snippet: Agentico is a lightweight, flexible solution that helps developers and teams build, integrate, and manage AI agents with ease. It's purpose-built to reduce complexity and time-to-deployment, enabling you to focus on solving real-world problems with cutting-edge AI. And guess what, it is based on MCP (Model Context Protocol).
